title: NASA Science: MESSENGER Mission
notes: NASA's MESSENGER was the first spacecraft to orbit Mercury. Its observations expanded knowledge of Mercury's surface composition, geological history, internal magnetic field, and polar deposits. The mission ended when the spacecraft impacted Mercury.

title: NASA Science: Magellan Mission
notes: Magellan mapped nearly all of Venus's surface with radar and revealed extensive volcanic terrain. The spacecraft's mission ended after a commanded plunge into Venus's atmosphere.

title: NASA Science: Galileo Mission
notes: Galileo orbited Jupiter and conducted close encounters with its major moons, while its atmospheric probe sampled Jupiter's atmosphere. The mission ended with a deliberate impact into Jupiter.

title: NASA Science: Cassini-Huygens Mission
notes: Cassini examined Saturn and its rings and moons for more than a decade. Its mission ended with a planned plunge into Saturn to help protect potentially habitable moons for future exploration.

title: NASA Science: Juno Mission
notes: Juno studies Jupiter from a polar orbit and, in its extended mission, also observes aspects of the wider Jovian system and selected major moons.

title: NASA Science: Voyager 2 Mission
notes: Voyager 2 completed close flybys of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune, then continued outward toward interstellar space. It is the only spacecraft to have flown by Uranus and Neptune.

title: NASA Science: New Horizons Mission
notes: New Horizons made the first close exploration of Pluto and later flew past Kuiper Belt object Arrokoth. NASA reported in July 2026 that the spacecraft had awakened from a long hibernation and was preparing to transmit new science data.
